summary: Normalized review summary: review_priority='review' is a human-triage recommendation only, not a truth score or authenticity verdict. Findings: one low-severity unsupported_claim (slide-01:itf-1): image label '抗老' for 欧莱雅超水光精华 lacks direct body-copy support; verdict insufficient_evidence; signal_score 0.4 is uncalibrated Qwen visual screening, not probability. Evidence_items: none. Image forensics: all images have legacy_forensics_disabled; AI-generation/NFA/TruFor/localization signals unavailable (not configured/not run), so no clean or fake image inference. Provenance: no C2PA manifest found for any image; no verifiable provenance available, not suspicious; EXIF for images 1-2 is Apple iPhone 15 Pro, image 3 has no EXIF (neutral). Semantic consistency: slide-01 MATCH; slides 02-03 NOT_VERIFIABLE. Image text claims: slide-01 efficacy claims (抗老/匀净透亮, 紧致淡纹) and slide-02 ingredient/numeric/efficacy claims (长盛松露配方, 10%高浓玻色因PRO, 干纹细纹改善) require evidence, none supplied; slide-01 '维稳脸蛋' is subjective, verification not applicable. Claim-evidence alignment: 0 supported, 0 contradicted, 5 insufficient among 5 evidence-requiring claims (claims 9,10,16,17,19); unmatched product/formula, population, endpoint, method, duration, comparator, result. Comments: available; sample_scope limited to 10 of 50 preview comments; no suspicious cluster found in supplied sample, only text-level pattern, cannot prove fake/coordinated/paid/identity/product use. Evidence cards mark visual forensics not_run, semantic consistency PARTIAL, comment anomaly no_clear_pattern. Missing: product detail/regulatory evidence, ingredient concentration documentation, efficacy study context, original C2PA/provenance assets, full comment data with relevant metadata.
recommended_actions: Human reviewer: check slide-01 '抗老' label against product details/body copy and official product page; treat as insufficient evidence, not contradiction.
Verify product/formula claims against official/regulatory sources: 长盛松露配方, 10%高浓玻色因PRO, PDRN, 能量素22 etc.; document source, population, endpoint, method, duration, comparator, result.
For efficacy claims (抗老/匀净透亮, 紧致淡纹, 干纹细纹改善), request clinical/consumer-study context or substantiation; no direct cited evidence currently.
Request original image assets and C2PA/provenance if available; no manifest means no verifiable provenance, not suspicion.
If pixel-level manipulation matters, run configured AI-generation/NFA/TruFor/localization providers; do not infer clean or fake from unavailable signals.

If comment authenticity matters, expand beyond the limited 10-comment preview with appropriate metadata/legal/privacy review; current sample shows no clear pattern and cannot establish coordination or fake reviews.
Use review_priority='review' for human triage only; low priority does not verify content.
limitations: 人工复核优先级是分流建议，不是真假结论或校准概率。
